terms.title: Platform terms
paragraphs: Nechto gives creators tools to publish portfolios and connect with visitors. Creators are responsible for profile accuracy, account security, and rights to uploaded material.
Illegal material, harassment, impersonation, spam, malicious links, and content that infringes third-party rights are prohibited. We may hide content or suspend a profile after review.
Creators retain ownership of their work and grant Nechto a non-exclusive license to store, technically process, and display it within the service.
For account, complaint, and data deletion requests, contact support@nechto.by.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
paragraphs: We process email, profile data, uploaded work, technical logs, sessions, and aggregated views/contact clicks to operate and protect the service.
Data is shared only with infrastructure, storage, and email providers needed to operate Nechto. We do not sell personal data.
Users can delete their account. Backups expire under the retention schedule; incident and complaint evidence may be retained longer when required by law or service protection.
For access, correction, or deletion requests, contact support@nechto.by.

community.title: Community guidelines
paragraphs: Publish your own work or material you are authorized to use. Provide clear titles and useful image descriptions.
Threats, degradation, discrimination, sexual exploitation, fraud, spam, and deliberate deception are prohibited.
Visitors can report violations from a creator page. A moderator reviews reports; profiles may be hidden and decisions are recorded in the moderation audit log.
Copyright reports should include the material URL, a description of the rights, and contact details: support@nechto.by.
